name: Vikki Bradt
crime: Charged: British national Vikki Bradt, 51, a lawful permanent resident, has been charged with voting by an alien.
usa: DOJ release Oct 16, 2026: Justice Department Announces Charges Involving 16 Aliens for Illegal Voting (Northern District of New York)
text: DOJ Oct 16, 2026, as posted: British national Vikki Bradt, 51, a lawful permanent resident, has been charged with voting by an alien. Bradt allegedly voted in an election held in part for the purpose of electing a candidate for President, Vice President, Member of the United States Senate, or Member of the United States House of Representatives. Residence per USAO-NDNY release (https://www.justice.gov/usao-ndny/pr/five-non-citizens-arrested-voter-fraud-across-northern-district): Ballston Spa, NY. The charges in the complaints are merely accusations.
